detail.content:
The Order Ticket page (/ticket).
Where: reached by address (/ticket) or from another page.

What you can do here (tool in brackets):
On the page:
- Account [ticket_account]
- Confirm each fill [ticket_confirm_fill]
- Extended hours [ticket_extended_hours]
- Panel [ticket_panel]
- Side [ticket_side]

What the page reports: state (its fields, lists and unavailable controls) and problems.
